headline: On last trading day, Sensex surged 898 points and Nifty reclaimed 25,800 led by banking stocks.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Strong rally led by banking and IT stocks lifting market recovery.
Support from foreign capital inflows during the session.
Nifty Bank surged to achieve a record high level.
Sharp rebound after early losses caused by global AI selloff concerns.
whatHappening: In the last session, Sensex jumped 898 points while Nifty 50 closed at 25,801.
Banking stocks spearheaded the rally, carrying Nifty Bank to an all-time high.
Apollo Hospitals was highlighted among the top leading stock gainers.
Markets successfully reversed early morning losses caused by hawkish Fed signals and global AI weakness.
summary:
In the last trading session, Indian markets staged a strong rally with Sensex surging 898 points and Nifty reclaiming 25,800.
The gains were powered by banking and IT stocks along with foreign inflows, driving Nifty Bank to a record high.
The stock market is closed today due to the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 23 November.
